scope: Original and C draft agree with independent lowest-set-bit model on Game Pak halt or acknowledgement mask, pending word and handler-table offset. No recognized pending bit selects offset 52 with mask zero. Optional selected-state checks cover r0-r12/CPSR and the known four-byte candidate stack decrement. Halt-state parity, IRQ mode transitions and actual handler execution are not checked; candidate is not byte-matching.
